test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 Quant Previous Year Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: general
question: A discount of 10% is offered on the price of an article if the payment is made online. An additional discount of 5% is given to credit card holders. A person wishes to buy a watch priced at Rs. 60,000 by paying online through credit card. How much does he need to pay (in Rs.)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net discount % for successive discounts of x% and y% = x + y − (x × y / 100)%

Total discount % = 10 + 5 − (10 × 5 / 100) = 15 − 0.5 = 14.5%

Selling Price = 100% − 14.5% = 85.5% of Marked Price

Selling Price = 60,000 × 0.855 = Rs. 51,300

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 51,300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Marked Price (MP) = Rs. 60,000

First discount (Online) = 10%

Second discount (Credit Card) = 5%

**Formula Used:**

Final Price = MP × (1 − d₁/100) × (1 − d₂/100)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea736bafbc1f7d80504b5e47b7e88c51d13c89fc3e22acedbf1d9a7a0bbab620.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 10% online discount = 60,000 − (10 / 100 × 60,000)

⇒ Price after 10% online discount = 60,000 − 6,000 = Rs. 54,000

⇒ Price after 5% credit card discount = 54,000 − (5 / 100 × 54,000)

⇒ Price after 5% credit card discount = 54,000 − 2,700

⇒ Final Amount = Rs. 51,300

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 51,300.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discounts Formula

For two successive discounts of a% and b%, the equivalent single discount is given by [a + b − (ab/100)]%.

Fraction Method for Discounts

Discounts can be solved by multiplying factors: 10% discount = 9/10 and 5% discount = 19/20. Final SP = MP × (9/10) × (19/20).

Marked Price vs Selling Price

Marked Price is the price printed on the label, while Selling Price is the actual price paid after deducting all applicable discounts.</p
